Projects

Real solutions for real clients

Group project

Congreso Aapresid 2026

Website developed for the 34th edition of the prestigious Aapresid Congress 2026, the region's most prominent international agricultural knowledge event, held under the motto "Our soil, our voice". Built with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4, the project features 9 complete sections and a robust internationalization (i18n) system using next-intl for full multilingual support. Premium libraries such as HeroUI were implemented for polished interface components, GSAP and Framer Motion for high-performance animations and micro-interactions, SwiperJS for dynamic galleries, and Google Maps API integration.

Live Demo
Individual project

Provincia Microcréditos

Institutional website developed for Provincia Microcréditos, a leading financial entity dedicated to supporting entrepreneurs and independent workers in the Province of Buenos Aires. The project implements a server-first architecture integrated with institutional REST APIs, featuring an interactive loan simulator, a dynamic branch locator using Google Maps with marker clustering, and secure forms protected by reCAPTCHA. Developed with Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, and TypeScript, the platform utilizes HeroUI and Tailwind CSS v4 for a modern UI, Framer Motion for micro-animations, and Sentry for error tracking.

Individual project

Congreso Aapresid 2025

Website developed for the prestigious Aapresid Congress, an international reference event that for over three decades has connected agricultural innovation, technology, and knowledge under the motto 'con la fuerza de Expoagro'. This project features 15 complete pages, translation system with i18next, and is developed with TypeScript. The development utilizes libraries such as Framer Motion for smooth animations, SwiperJS for multimedia galleries, and Tailwind for responsive design.

Lab

Experimental space exploring new technologies and frameworks

Individual project

Wakarimasuka?

Wakarimasuka? is a premium platform designed to improve Japanese listening comprehension through real-world content such as anime, songs, and news. It features synchronized smart transcriptions, real-time morphological analysis using Kuromoji, and an integrated feedback system. Japanese to Spanish translation is powered by Gemini AI integration, ensuring accuracy and fluency.

Live Demo
Individual project / Web Tool

Size Match

Web tool designed for motorcyclists to simplify the search for technical spare parts (such as brake discs or sprockets) using exact measurements. It allows users to quickly find the perfect part code, eliminating the frustration of endless searches.
